title: Luc Montagnier on electromagnetic information transfer in DNA

tellings.quote: and you had this guy Luke Monier who's this French Nobel Prize winner at the end of his life if he was saying you know electromagnetism is really important for communication information transfer within DNA

plain: A French Nobel Prize winner named Luc Montagnier was saying, at the end of his life, that electromagnetism plays an important part in communication and information transfer within DNA. Michels brings this up himself, without naming a source, in a conversation about synchronicities and prophetic dreams, as a sign that living things might send and receive information in ways science has barely looked at.
